notes: Single-stage food pipeline: GGCD YOLOv8n INT8 for 241-class bounding-box detection. VLM identifies food items post-detection. Classification stage removed in Phase 7.

models.name: GGCD YOLOv8n (241-Class Food Detection)
models.description: YOLOv8n trained on Global Gastronomic Culinary Dataset. 241 food-specific classes spanning Central Asian, South Asian, East Asian, Middle Eastern, European, and American cuisines. INT8 quantized for mobile. NMS performed in JavaScript.

models.name: MiniLM-L6-v2 (Sentence Embedding)
models.description: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 with mean pooling and L2 normalisation baked in. Produces 384-dim normalised float32 vectors for on-device vector search. INT8 dynamic-range quantised for mobile.
